label: River, hero faces a large bet after calling the flop and the turn

confidence.note: The lowest-confidence template in the set and the one to review first. River decisions against a large bet depend almost entirely on the exact composition of the bettor's range after three streets of aggression, which my authored ranges do not model to that depth — the villainRange string here is descriptive rather than parseable notation and should be replaced with a real range when 2.8-2.10 runs. The one thing I would defend is the SHAPE: hero is capped by calling twice and must fold a lot. Do not present the specific frequencies to a user as authoritative.

strategies.rationale: A straight is near the top of a capped calling range — raise for value against their bluffs.
Strong enough to raise, though a big raise only gets called by better.
A comfortable call. Raising turns a made hand into a bluff against a polarised range.
A genuine bluff-catcher. Call slightly more than half against a range with missed draws in it.
Weak top pair beats only bluffs, and a large river bet is not mostly bluffs.
Fold. Middle pair on a wet river facing a big bet is beaten by every value hand.
Almost a pure fold — this hand cannot beat a single value bet.
Ace high never calls a large river bet from a range that has been betting three streets.
Fold. Bluff-raising here would need a blocker story this range does not have.
